verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a consumer agent service, but the evidence documents no public Muse API. Probes found no published API spec or llms.txt (401) and no discovery or spec route on api.muse.ai (404). Muse building connectors to other services' APIs, and users downloading VM files, are adjacent capabilities and do not amount to programmatic access to Muse's own UI functions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
